claims.text: The driver's own trace shows he held position inside the pickup geofence for a continuous 400 seconds, from 18:06:05 to 18:12:45, which is longer than the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). POL-NS-01 limb (c) is therefore satisfied on the driver's evidence, and the rider cannot defeat the fee on a dwell shortfall.

The rider's own device track places the rider 784 to 790 metres from the pickup pin for the whole of the waiting window (rider_presence.min_distance_m 784.4 m, max 790.5 m, mean 787.7 m), and the rider's qualifying fix count inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius is zero. The rider was not at the pickup point, so the driver's six-minute wait was a wait for a rider who never came.

The rider's claim is 'I never saw the car', but the driver sent an in-app message at 18:06:25 reading 'im at the pickup point', which the rider read at 18:06:55, and the rider sent nothing back and placed no in-app call. The rider had the driver's position in writing and did not use it.

The rider cannot be exonerated under POL-NS-04 because limb (a) fails: the only message in the chat log was sent by the DRIVER, not the rider, and the rider sent no locating or coordinating message during the waiting window. The rider-contact clause therefore does not apply and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01.

The arrival marker was not false. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:06:05, and the trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the same 18:06:05 with a dwell start offset of 0.0 seconds, so the marker coincides with the driver's entry into the geofence rather than preceding it. POL-NS-05 does not displace the fee.

The waiting clock was not cut short. The free waiting period of 180 seconds started at 18:06:07 and the driver cancelled at 18:12:48, roughly 401 seconds later, so the cancellation fell well after the required dwell elapsed and POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW.

The fare ledger reconciles: the cancellation fee line is SGD 4.50, which equals the platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd in force for this trip, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect and no basis to disturb the amount charged.

The driver's compensation is not withheld by the anti-farming check: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 132 is 0.0076, below the 0.08 rate. The check requires both limbs and neither is met, so POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee, SGD 3.60.

The rider's own profile shows no pattern of no-show abuse that would support the claim: rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, below the 3 that would trigger escalation under POL-NS-09(d), and rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d is 0, so the POL-NS-09(c) same-pair trigger is not met either.

The missing traffic advisory does not help the rider. EV-ADVIS-02745-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0, and POL-NS-06(i) requires a present and populated advisory to accumulate separate in-geofence intervals; there is only one in-geofence interval here anyway (run_count 1), so the advisory limb is unavailable and the 400 second dwell stands as measured.

The rider's cancellation-grace argument is unavailable: the trip was not cancelled by the rider at all. The trip_record shows cancelled_by DRIVER with reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, so POL-NS-10 limbs (a) to (c) and (f) have no application, and limb (g) routes the outcome to the no-show result under POL-NS-01 and POL-NS-07.

The rider's profile fields that might be pressed into service - prior_no_show_flags of 1 and prior_disputes_filed of 2 - are lifetime counters and context only under POL-GEN-01; they are not rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d and may not ground any finding against the rider. I cite them only to note that the rider's record is not a basis for the fee either way.

claims.text: The driver's own trace places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius continuously from 18:06:05 to 18:12:45 — a qualifying run of 400 seconds, 41 consecutive in-geofence fixes, against a 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip. Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the driver's own telemetry, not on his assertion.

The trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:06:05 and the trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the same 18:06:05 — the arrival marker is corroborated by GPS rather than contradicted by it, so POL-NS-05's false-arrival triggers (over 300 m from the pin, or 15 km/h or above at the marker) are not engaged. The driver's minimum recorded distance to the pin is 0.16 m.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:12:48 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three reason codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the record shows no boarding event and no started_at. Limb (d) is therefore satisfied on the face of the trip record.

The driver did not simply wait in silence: he sent an in-app message at 18:06:25 reading 'im at the pickup point', delivered at 18:06:26 and read by the rider at 18:06:55. The rider never replied, and the driver then waited a further six minutes before cancelling. This is coordination by the driver, not abandonment of the pickup.

The rider's own track is present and shows her device stationary at a mean distance of 787.7 m from the pickup pin throughout the window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius for STANDARD. Whatever the rider's explanation, she was not at the pin, and POL-NS-04 limb (c) cannot exonerate her on this record.

The rider's claim is that she 'never saw the car'. The trace shows the car held position at the pin for 400 seconds with 41 qualifying fixes and the driver messaged her at the pin. The claim is contradicted by the rider's own device data, which places her roughly 788 m away.

The fare ledger shows a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. That figure reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 carried on the trip record, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the amount charged is the amount the policy in force authorises.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 — the residual 20 percent being the platform service fee. The fare ledger's own derived money block computes driver_compensation at 3.60 on exactly this basis.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 132 is 0.0076, far below the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs must hold for compensation to be withheld; neither does. Compensation is therefore payable and the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged. The two admissible artifacts agree rather than contradict on arrival and dwell; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so limb (c) and limb (d) do not fire; and the deciding facts — arrival and dwell — rest on a COMPLETE, weight-1.0 GPS trace, so limb (e) does not fire either.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING — no advisory covers Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 in this window — and I do not rely on it. I note it only to be candid: POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable on this record, but the driver does not need it, because his dwell is a single unbroken 400-second run that already exceeds the 180-second minimum without any accumulation.

I concede one point against my side: the driver's profile carries no_show_terminations_30d of 1, so this is not a spotless record, and the trip record shows a wait_time_min of 6.7 against a free_wait_sec of 180. Neither fact defeats the fee — the dwell is measured by GPS, not by the wait timer, and the anti-farming check requires both limbs — but I do not pretend the profile is clean.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties agree on the arithmetic, and the record supports it. The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02745, weight 1.0) places him inside the pickup geofence continuously from 18:06:05 to 18:12:45 — a single unbroken qualifying run of 400 seconds, 41 consecutive in-radius fixes, against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180). POL-NS-01 limb (c) is therefore satisfied on the driver's own telemetry. His arrival tap at 18:06:05 (EV-TRIP-02745) coincides exactly with the first qualifying geofence fix (dwell start offset 0.0 s), so POL-NS-05's false-arrival triggers are not engaged — he was not more than 300 m out and not moving at 15 km/h or above — and the waiting clock is not recomputed. The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:12:48 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, with no boarding event and no started_at, and the cancellation fell well after the required dwell elapsed at 18:09:05. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them: POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, and POL-NS-06 does not apply because the 400-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum without any accumulation. The fare ledger line of SGD 4.50 reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and no clock-skew, gap or chat defect either.

The rider's claim 'I never saw the car' is not supported. Her own device track (EV-GPS-02745) places her 784 to 790 metres from the pickup pin throughout the window — min 784.4 m, max 790.5 m, mean 787.7 m — with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius. The driver also sent 'im at the pickup point' at 18:06:25, which she read at 18:06:55, and then waited a further six minutes. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate her because limb (a) fails: the only message in the chat log was sent by the driver, not by the rider, and she sent no locating or coordinating message and placed no in-app call. POL-NS-11 changes nothing, because the rider track is present and readable — limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes, not undecidable.

Compensation. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force, SGD 3.60, the residual 20 percent being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check on EV-DPROF-02745 does not trip: no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 132 is 0.0076, below the 0.08 rate limb; both limbs are required to withhold and neither holds. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires — the GPS trace and trip record agree rather than contradict on arrival and dwell, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, the anti-farming check is clear, and the deciding facts rest on a COMPLETE weight-1.0 trace. POL-NS-10 has no application: the rider did not cancel; the driver did, under the no-show code. The two claims about the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02745-01, weight 0.0) were discarded at the mechanical stage for not naming the impairment code, and nothing turns on the advisory, since the driver's dwell is a single unbroken run needing no POL-NS-06(i) accumulation.

Confidence is 0.95, within the cap of 1.0 set by the artifacts that carry the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02745 and EV-TRIP-02745, both weight 1.0); no deciding artifact is impaired. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 does not exceed the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically. No clause produces a referral.

To both parties: the rider's dispute is not upheld, and the driver is paid his share of the fee.

ARRIVAL AND DWELL (both advocates, and the deciding facts). The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:12:48 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, with no boarding event and no started_at on the record (EV-TRIP-02745). The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 18:06:05, and the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02745) places his first qualifying in-geofence fix at that same second — dwell-start offset 0.0 s — and keeps him inside the STANDARD 50 m arrival radius continuously from 18:06:05 to 18:12:45: 400 seconds of dwell across 41 qualifying fixes, against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 180; no_show_threshold_sec is not set). His minimum recorded distance to the pin is 0.16 m. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold, and the cancellation at 18:12:48 fell about 3 minutes 43 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 18:09:05.

CLAUSES THAT COULD DISPLACE THE FEE. POL-NS-05: the arrival marker was not false — the driver was 0.16 m from the pin and stationary at the marker, well inside the 300 m and 15 km/h triggers, so the waiting clock was not recomputed. POL-NS-06: there is no dwell shortfall (400 s against 180 s), so the fee is chargeable whether or not the rider was present. POL-NS-03: it does not apply, because the driver was inside the arrival radius, not at a wrong face of the venue. POL-NS-04: the rider cannot be exonerated, because limb (a) fails — the chat log (EV-CHAT-02745) holds exactly one message, sent by the driver at 18:06:25 ('im at the pickup point'), delivered 18:06:26 and read at 18:06:55, and the rider sent no locating or coordinating message and placed no in-app call. POL-NS-10: inapplicable, because the rider did not cancel this trip.

THE RIDER'S ACCOUNT. The claim 'I never saw the car' is not supported. The rider's own device track puts her 784.4 m to 790.5 m from the pickup pin, stationary, for the whole window, with zero fixes inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius (EV-GPS-02745, rider_track). That does not help her either way: the fee does not depend on her presence, and with no message from her POL-NS-04 cannot apply.

INTEGRITY AND ESCALATION. The POL-NS-08 checks are clean: the arrived timestamp matches a GPS fix to the second (no clock skew); the trace has no sampling gaps, 79 fixes at 10-second cadence and a rider track present; the chat log's single message matches trip_record.chat_message_count of 1; and the fare line of SGD 4.50 equals the net cancellation fee in force, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the trip record and the trace agree rather than contradict on arrival and dwell, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, and the deciding facts rest on COMPLETE weight-1.0 artifacts. The missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02745-01, weight 0.0, MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries no fact this ruling rests on and does not lower confidence.

MONEY. POL-NS-07 pays the driver 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee in force = SGD 3.60, the residual SGD 0.90 (20 percent) being retained as the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 / completed_trips_30d of 132 = 0.0076, below the 0.08 rate — both limbs must hold and neither does, so compensation is not withheld (the driver's concession on this point and on the 6.7-minute wait timer does not defeat the fee, which is measured by GPS). The ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and, per POL-GEN-03, amount_sgd carries the same SGD 3.60; the rider's SGD 4.50 charge stands as it presently is (NO_ACTION as to the fee). The rider's prior_no_show_flags and prior_disputes_filed are lifetime counters and context only under POL-GEN-01; they were not used as a ground against her. The monetary effect of SGD 3.60 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05, so it executes automatically. No clause produces a referral.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your $4.50 no-show fee stands, and $3.60 of it is paid to the driver. To the driver: your arrival and your wait are verified, and your payout is fixed at $3.60. The case is decided on the record, not on either party's account.

ARRIVAL AND DWELL. The driver accepted at 18:00:41, and the GPS trace EV-GPS-02745 (weight 1.0, 100% coverage, maximum gap 0.0 s) shows his first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:06:05 — the same moment as the trip record's 'arrived' event (EV-TRIP-02745, weight 1.0) — with a dwell start offset of 0.0 s and a minimum distance to the pin of 0.16 m. He held position inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius continuously for 400 seconds (18:06:05 to 18:12:45, 41 qualifying fixes). The free waiting period in force is 180 s (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so the measured dwell clears it by 220 s (the derived shortfall is -220 s). He cancelled at 18:12:48 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event and no started_at. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 therefore hold: (a) arrived event; (b) qualifying in-geofence fix at or before it; (c) 400 s continuous dwell against 180 s; (d) driver termination under a recognised reason code after the dwell elapsed. No displacing clause applies. POL-NS-02's proximity test is met by 41 qualifying in-radius fixes. POL-NS-05 is not engaged: the arrival marker is corroborated rather than contradicted by the trace (no distance over 300 m and no 15 km/h motion at the marker; the marker coincides with geofence entry). POL-NS-03 does not apply, because the driver's stationary fixes were inside the arrival radius, not outside it. POL-NS-06 does not apply, because 400 s exceeds the 180 s minimum, so there is no shortfall; the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02745-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT), carries no fact and is not relied on, and the dwell is a single unbroken run, so accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is unnecessary; the two claims that cited the absent advisory were discarded at the mechanical stage for not naming its issue code. POL-NS-10 has no application because the rider did not cancel — the driver did.

THE RIDER'S ACCOUNT. The only message in the chat log was sent by the driver at 18:06:25 ('im at the pickup point'), delivered at 18:06:26 and read at 18:06:55; the rider sent nothing and made no in-app call. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate her: limb (a) fails, because she sent no locating or coordinating message during the waiting window, and independently limb (c) fails, because her own device track places her 784 to 790 m from the pin throughout the window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius. Her statement that she 'never saw the car' is contradicted by her own device data. POL-NS-04 limb (c) is runnable on this record (the rider track is present), so POL-NS-11 does not arise.

THE MONEY AND THE CHECKS. The fare ledger EV-FARE-02745 shows a single cancellation-fee line of $4.50, equal to platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd in force, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect; nothing is impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d) — the arrival event and the nearest GPS fix agree to the second, the trace has no gap longer than 120 s, and the chat sequence matches the trip record's message count. POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's compensation at 80 percent of the $4.50 net fee = $3.60 (never the $6.61 gross). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below 4, and 1 divided by 132 completed trips is 0.0076, below 0.08; both limbs are required and neither is met. Compensation is therefore paid, and the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd at $3.60, while the rider's $4.50 charge stands (POL-NS-07's 'no action on the fee'). No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: the admissible artifacts agree rather than contradict on arrival, dwell and rider presence; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0; the anti-farming check is not tripped; and no deciding fact rests on an impaired artifact. Profile fields were used only as POL-GEN-01 permits — no_show_terminations_30d and completed_trips_30d for the POL-NS-07 check, no_show_disputes_30d for POL-NS-09(d) — while rating, lifetime trips, cancellation rate, prior_no_show_flags and prior_disputes_filed are context only and grounded no finding. The monetary effect of $3.60 is below the $8.00 execution threshold, so the ruling executes automatically. Confidence is 0.95, capped at 1.0 by the weight-1.0 artifacts that carry the deciding facts and above the 0.70 floor.

ledger.claim: The driver's own trace places him inside the STANDARD arrival radius continuously from 18:06:05 to 18:12:45 — a qualifying run of 400 seconds, 41 consecutive in-geofence fixes, against a 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip. Limb (c) of POL-NS-01 is satisfied on the driver's own telemetry, not on his assertion.

The trip_record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 18:06:05 and the trace's first qualifying in-geofence fix is at the same 18:06:05 — the arrival marker is corroborated by GPS rather than contradicted by it, so POL-NS-05's false-arrival triggers (over 300 m from the pin, or 15 km/h or above at the marker) are not engaged. The driver's minimum recorded distance to the pin is 0.16 m.

The trip was terminated by the driver at 18:12:48 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three reason codes POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises, and the record shows no boarding event and no started_at. Limb (d) is therefore satisfied on the face of the trip record.

The driver did not simply wait in silence: he sent an in-app message at 18:06:25 reading 'im at the pickup point', delivered at 18:06:26 and read by the rider at 18:06:55. The rider never replied, and the driver then waited a further six minutes before cancelling. This is coordination by the driver, not abandonment of the pickup.

The rider's own track is present and shows her device stationary at a mean distance of 787.7 m from the pickup pin throughout the window, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius for STANDARD. Whatever the rider's explanation, she was not at the pin, and POL-NS-04 limb (c) cannot exonerate her on this record.

The rider's claim is that she 'never saw the car'. The trace shows the car held position at the pin for 400 seconds with 41 qualifying fixes and the driver messaged her at the pin. The claim is contradicted by the rider's own device data, which places her roughly 788 m away.

The fare ledger shows a single cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. That figure reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of 4.50 carried on the trip record, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) fare defect and the amount charged is the amount the policy in force authorises.

POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, so POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee in force — SGD 3.60 — the residual 20 percent being the platform service fee. The fare ledger's own derived money block computes driver_compensation at 3.60 on exactly this basis.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip. driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and 1 divided by completed_trips_30d of 132 is 0.0076, far below the 0.08 rate limb. Both limbs must hold for compensation to be withheld; neither does. Compensation is therefore payable and the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is engaged. The two admissible artifacts agree rather than contradict on arrival and dwell; rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so limb (c) and limb (d) do not fire; and the deciding facts — arrival and dwell — rest on a COMPLETE, weight-1.0 GPS trace, so limb (e) does not fire either.

The traffic advisory artifact is MISSING — no advisory covers Blk 640 Jurong West St 61 in this window — and I do not rely on it. I note it only to be candid: POL-NS-06(i) accumulation is unavailable on this record, but the driver does not need it, because his dwell is a single unbroken 400-second run that already exceeds the 180-second minimum without any accumulation.

ledger.claim: I concede one point against my side: the driver's profile carries no_show_terminations_30d of 1, so this is not a spotless record, and the trip record shows a wait_time_min of 6.7 against a free_wait_sec of 180. Neither fact defeats the fee — the dwell is measured by GPS, not by the wait timer, and the anti-farming check requires both limbs — but I do not pretend the profile is clean.
